title: Tamsin and the Archive
author: Coral Zhou
blurb: Beatrix Dunmore, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
